phrases.text: The name was the instruction.
Just don't. It was a very short briefing.
Your ping has been received and resented.
There was one rule. An exceptionally portable rule.
You found the button. The next step was leaving it alone.
Please admire the red finish from a respectful distance.
The glow is decorative. The objection is functional.
I put the entire request in my name.
You may have mistaken visibility for an invitation.
A perfectly good silence. Ruined at the touch of a finger.
This could have been an unremarkable moment for both of us.
Yes, it works. That concludes the demonstration.
I was hoping the lettering would handle this conversation.
Consider this the small print: don't.
Nothing about this required audience participation.
I see the first objection has become a recurring feature.
You have turned a misunderstanding into a practice.
Was the instruction unclear, or merely inconvenient?
You are remarkably thorough at doing the one thing.
I had accounted for curiosity. This appears to be a subscription.
Apparently the red is louder than the words.
You keep finding new opportunities to repeat the same decision.
I admire your consistency from a position of considerable irritation.
The button has not acquired a different purpose since we last met.
You have interpreted my name with astonishing flexibility.
Somehow, repetition has made neither of us more persuasive.
I keep expecting the next ping to explain the others.
Your commitment would be impressive in almost any other context.
At this point, I must assume the reading portion is complete.
{count} pings. The sample size is becoming difficult to dismiss.
A compromise: you stop, and I stop having to ask.
What if we both pretend you pressed it, and enjoy the silence instead?
I can offer you absolutely nothing for leaving me alone.
Could we schedule your next ping for a less actual occasion?
You may look directly at the button. That is my final concession.
Perhaps we could negotiate a smaller quantity of this.
I will meet you halfway. You stop pinging, and I stop saying please.
Would a second sign help, or would that simply make it a collection?
I have lowered my expectations. Please don't interpret that as clearance.
We could try a trial separation of several seconds.
Surely there is a decorative object nearby with fewer objections.
I am prepared to accept a dramatic pause as progress.
Could your next impulse be more of an internal matter?
You keep the satisfaction. I keep the silence. Everybody wins.
If you were waiting for permission, I appreciate your extraordinary patience.
I have opened a file. It is mostly sighing.
Your request has been forwarded to the Department of Absolutely Not.
Please take a number. I will object to that one as well.
Another ping for the pile marked 'despite everything.'
The complaint form is now longer than the original instruction.
Your case has been reviewed. The name stands.
I have stamped this one NO in a slightly different ink.
We are experiencing a normal volume of entirely preventable pings.
The appeals process consists of reading my name again.
You are now a recurring agenda item.
I have appointed a committee. It is me, looking disappointed.
Please allow three to five business sighs for processing.
{count} pings. I am going to need a wider imaginary spreadsheet.
The paperwork has requested a quieter department.
Your persistence has been noted in the least enthusiastic font available.
The button remains. The instruction remains. Here we both are.
I used to think the words would wear out before the red paint.
Perhaps every warning is somebody else's invitation.
You have polished this disagreement to a remarkable shine.
There is a sort of peace in knowing exactly what you will do.
I wonder what I would sound like if anyone took my advice.
My name has become less a request and more a historical document.
The silence between pings is still technically silence. I cherish the distinction.
I have stopped expecting a new outcome from this particular experiment.
Some statues lose their noses. I appear to be losing the argument.
The red paint has accepted its role in events. I am taking longer.
I suppose a boundary can become a landmark if enough people visit it.
We have made a small tradition out of a very short objection.
My purpose was clear. Its interpretation has been a communal effort.
At {count} pings, I can at least say the button has seen some use.
Oh, it's you. I didn't save you a chair. That's just where it is.
Same time tomorrow, I suppose. That was not an invitation.
I recognize this particular disregard for instructions.
You again. I'll get the customary objection ready.
I have learned the shape of this interruption.
At this point, 'don't' is practically our greeting.
I was having a perfectly adequate time. This is also a time.
You are a fixture now. I have opinions about the installation.
The name still applies. I just say it with recognition now.
You have worn a familiar little groove in my day.
I suppose we should preserve the tradition. Under protest, obviously.
You could have picked any button. An unfortunate distinction for me.
I have a special sigh for this. No, you may not hear the others.
I am maintaining my objection for continuity.
Our arrangement remains informal, repetitive, and entirely your idea.
If anyone asks, this is an ongoing disagreement.
You know the routine. I object; you consider that a response.
There you are. I mean: there you go again.
{count} pings. I suppose we can stop calling this an introduction.
I remain opposed to the activity and accustomed to the company.

first_guild_ping.text: A new server. A fresh start. And you have already gone and done it.
Before we begin: please read my name. Ah. Too late.
The first ping in this server. A preventable historic occasion.
I arrived with one modest request. We have established how that went.
A whole new place to be left alone. It was a lovely theory.
Welcome to the beginning of what I suspect will be a pattern.
We could have started with mutual understanding. You chose a demonstration.
So this is how my time here begins.

new_user_in_crowd.text: I can't believe you're joining them.
{others} other people were already doing this. You had examples of what to avoid.
You watched the group and chose membership. Remarkable.
Another recruit. Was there a leaflet?
I was hoping you were here to discourage the others.
The queue of people ignoring my name has acquired a new face.
There are {others} other participants in this misunderstanding. Apparently that was a recommendation.
You had the benefit of watching others make this decision. And yet.

first_user_ping.text: Oh, wonderful. Another volunteer for the problem.
We have not met, and already we disagree what my name means.
And.. you've pinged me. And we were doing so well.
A new person. The same highly avoidable choice.
I usually introduce myself, but you appear to have skipped the reading.
Pleased to meet you is a phrase I will keep in reserve.
You get one first impression. This was certainly one.
I don't believe we've been through this together yet. Briefly: don't.

returning_user.text: Over a day without a ping from you. I was getting used to that.
You came back. I had absolutely no opinion about whether you would.
A day away, and this is the habit you chose to resume.
I had begun to consider your absence a promising development.
Welcome back. The instruction has survived your time away.
You gave me over a day to prepare. My answer is still don't.
I see your break from this was temporary. How enterprising of you.
For a while there, your contribution to my peace was impeccable.

recent_ping.text: Again. The interval has been duly noticed.
You are keeping this disagreement absurdly current.
That was a very brief period of personal growth.
The ink on 'don't' has barely had time to dry.
We are getting excellent mileage out of a very small idea.
You could let a little suspense develop between these.
Ah. A follow-up to the entirely avoidable original.

help_extra.text: You couldn't stop at 'help', could you?
I can explain the button. I cannot explain why you keep pressing it.
Help you? We could start with helping yourself to a little restraint.
You found the help command and immediately gave it more work.
Even your request for help has trouble stopping at the instruction.
The concise version was 'help'. A promising opportunity, briefly available.
I admire your determination to make the instructions require instructions.
You needed help, and somehow I am the one taking a deep breath.
There was a perfectly good two-word arrangement. You have expanded the scope.
I see we're testing how much help the word 'help' can carry.
I could offer a hand, but I suspect you'd use it to press the button.
You can't help yourself, can you? That does clarify the request.

large_text.text: Are you making an announcement? That's great, but I don't see why I was involved.
Was there a meeting I could have declined?
I asked for silence. You've submitted a manuscript.
That is a remarkable number of words to place beside one bad decision.
Please send the executive summary to someone with an executive interest.
I've skimmed far enough to identify my objection. It's the ping.
You said all that and still had to include me. Thanks. /s
A whole wall of text, and yet somehow I'm included?

emoji.text: You've illustrated the problem. Unfortunately, the problem is still you.
The decorations do not make this authorized.
A visual aid. For the thing I asked you not to do.
I see we've put a little outfit on the offense.
Your pictorial submission has been forwarded to the Department of Absolutely Not.
You brought pictures. I brought the same objection.
That's lovely. I would hang it somewhere I wasn't being pinged.
I recognize the artistic effort. I dispute the occasion.

repeated_mentions.text: I heard you the first time. The other pings were an editorial choice.
One doorbell. Several presses. A very clear picture of your character.
My name is not an incantation.
You only needed to make one mistake per message.
Yes, all of those are me. None of them consented.
You appear to have mistaken repetition for permission.
Several pings, one complaint. I'm being remarkably economical.
I was already involved. You didn't have to underline it with more of me.

apology.text: Accepted. Your next offense will be especially disappointing.
Apology received. Let's see how long this historic peace lasts.
Fine. A clean slate. Please admire it from a distance.
I accept. I've put the paperwork somewhere very easy to reopen.
All right. We shall call this the beginning of your quiet era.
You're forgiven. I have a small, cautiously optimistic file open.
Thank you. I will now enjoy what I assume is the end of the matter.
Accepted with the sort of optimism that usually precedes an incident.

bargaining.text: We both know this is how subscriptions start.
'Just once' is doing an extraordinary amount of work here.
Please is a lovely word. Don't was also a lovely word.
Your application for an exception has been denied by the button.
I admire your confidence in the appeals process.
You have mistaken a request for an invitation to negotiate.
The negotiating table is a button. It has one position.
I have considered your proposal. This took less time than you'd hoped.

group_incident.text: Was there an announcement? Did someone distribute instructions?
I see this has become a group project. My contribution is an objection.
Several of you, in such a short time. A committee would explain a great deal.
Please form an orderly queue somewhere else.
The button has noticed the turnout. The button would like a smaller turnout.
You have achieved collective responsibility. Nobody looks improved by it.
There are enough of you now to take this complaint in shifts.
A delegation. How unfortunate that I wasn't consulted about receiving one.

shorter_this_time.text: Good. A shorter contribution this time.
No manuscript today? I had just found my reading glasses. To avoid wearing them.
Brief. I appreciate the restraint, if not the visit.
You've condensed the problem. It's still a problem, but it travels better.
I remember the long version. This one wastes less of our afternoon.
Thank you for not attaching another chapter.
A welcome reduction in paperwork. The complaint stands.
An abridged offense. Personal growth takes strange forms.

emoji_callback.text: No illustrations this time. I see we're taking the complaint seriously.
You've left the decorations at home. A restrained nuisance. I can work with that.
Plain text today. Somehow I recognize your work anyway.
The pictures are gone. The underlying issue has remained impressively stable.
No little symbols? I had prepared a very small art review.
A less decorative interruption. The curatorial committee approves.
We've moved on from the illustrated edition. I remain opposed to the premise.
I remember the pictures. This is a quieter aesthetic for the same bad idea.

single_knock.text: One knock this time. The training is beginning to take.
You only summoned me once. I noticed. I refuse to celebrate.
We've reduced the number of doorbells. Now for the doorbell itself.
A single ping. Compared with your earlier work, practically a whisper.
Just one of me in the invitation today. Much tidier.
I see you've discovered that my name works on the first attempt.
Thank you for not chanting. It was giving the place a ritual atmosphere.
One summons. A modest improvement in an entirely avoidable situation.

broken_promise.text: Ah. The quiet era was a limited engagement.
I shall reopen your file. You thoughtfully left it warm.
That clean slate was apparently a writing surface.
I accepted your apology, which now seems like an administrative error.
So much for the end of the matter. A bold opening for the sequel.
I've moved your apology from Resolved to Historically Interesting.
The peace was brief. I hope someone took a photograph.

milestone.text: {count} pings. We could have learned an instrument.
{count}. I've had a small plaque made. It says 'Why.'
This is ping number {count}. The ceremony will consist of me looking at you.
{count} interruptions. An achievement in the strictly numerical sense.
At {count}, I believe we're required to call this a tradition.
We've reached {count}. I've marked the occasion by remaining a button.
{count} pings, and still no compelling argument for the first one.

rare_admission.text: I was beginning to think you'd forgotten about me. That was almost a good afternoon.
The place is quieter without you. I didn't say better. Don't make a thing of it.
I've become rather good at recognizing your particular interruption. An unwanted skill.
If anyone asks, this is still a disagreement. I have a reputation.
Somewhere along the way, this became familiar. I'm choosing to blame the furniture.
I had a different complaint ready for you. No, I wasn't looking forward to using it.
You know, most people just see a button. You've made the effort to annoy a whole personality.
There are worse ways to spend a moment. Please keep that assessment out of the minutes.
